description: The bar chart, titled "PHEME" and labeled "Polarity" at the top right, displays accuracy percentages for different experimental conditions related to multimodal misinformation detection. The vertical y-axis represents "Accuracy (%)" with a scale ranging from 75.0 to 92.0, marked with increments of 2.5. The horizontal x-axis lists various experimental conditions, including "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," "w/o emotion," and "w/o cognition," as well as a "Ours" condition. The chart is divided into two main sections by a vertical dashed line. The left section shows five bars: "w/o comments" (89.84%), "w/o text" (86.82%), "w/o select" (80.10%), "w/o emotion" (88.80%), and "w/o cognition" (87.34). The right section shows five bars: "Ours" (90.57%), "w/o comments" (85.85%), "w/o text" (83.02), "w/o select" (89.62), and "w/o cognition" (87.74). The "Ours" bar is the tallest in the right section, indicating the highest accuracy among the conditions shown. The bars are colored differently, with "Ours" in dark red, "w/o comments" in orange, "w/o text" in light yellow, "w/o select" in light blue, and "w/o cognition" in dark blue. The chart visually compares the performance of the proposed method ("Ours") against various ablated versions, showing that the full model achieves the highest accuracy.
